cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
I think that in case that clientSession is not null, the issuer should be still kept to `clientSession.getNote(OIDCLoginProtocol.ISSUER);` . The issuer based on `Urls.realmIssuer(session.getContext().getUri().getBaseUri(), realm.getName())` should be used just in case that clientSession is null.

I believe this is the reason of the test failures, which look like regression of this PR (EG. DefaultHostnameTest).
